links.comparator_used: No prompting (Form 1) compared with patient-friendly (Form 2) and physician-level (Form 3) audience prompting
links.outcome: Response word count and Flesch-Kincaid grade level (accuracy was also scored across all forms)
links.effect: Physician-level prompts gave a higher word count across both platforms (p < 0.001). ChatGPT had a higher FK grade level with physician-level prompting (p = 0.033). Most responses were at collegiate reading level, above NIH recommendations. The abstract gives no separate accuracy or readability result for patient-friendly versus no prompting.
links.tradeoff: Physician-level audience prompts produced longer responses. Most responses stayed at collegiate reading level, above NIH recommendations.
links.quote: Physician-level prompts resulted in a higher word count across both platforms (p < 0.001).

design_hint: reading-level and audience prompting (patient-friendly vs physician-level prompts)
